parts.text:
23 Which statement about progressive longitudinal waves is not correct?
A
The oscillations of the particles are parallel to the direction of travel of the wave energy.
B
They have a series of nodes and antinodes.
C
They need a medium through which to travel.
D
They transfer energy.

hints: Look at the two key words in the stem: progressive means travelling and transferring energy, and longitudinal means the particle vibrations are along the energy direction.
Recall what nodes with zero amplitude and antinodes with maximum amplitude require - two opposite travelling waves superposing to form a stationary wave.
Check each statement against sound as an example of a progressive longitudinal wave that needs air to travel and carries energy without fixed nodes.
walkthrough: Identify the test: a progressive wave travels and transfers energy, and longitudinal means the particles vibrate parallel to that travel, for example compressions and rarefactions in sound.
Statement A describes the definition of longitudinal, so particle motion parallel to wave energy travel is true for this wave.
Statement D describes a progressive wave, which transfers energy from source to receiver, so it is true.
Statement C describes a mechanical wave such as sound, which needs a medium of particles to vibrate and cannot travel through a vacuum, so it is true.
Nodes and antinodes occur only when two identical progressive waves travel in opposite directions and superpose to make a stationary wave with no net energy transfer.
Therefore the only statement that is not correct for a progressive longitudinal wave is the nodes and antinodes statement. This is option B.

A.explanation: This is correct physics for a longitudinal wave, where particle oscillation is parallel to energy travel, as in sound.

B.explanation: Nodes and antinodes are a feature of stationary waves, not progressive waves where all particles oscillate with the same amplitude.

C.explanation: This is correct because longitudinal waves such as sound are mechanical and require particles of a medium to oscillate.

D.explanation: This is correct because all progressive waves carry energy from one place to another without net transfer of matter.
